notes.subject: מארבה
notes.rationale: 'da-ɲɛfɛlan' walima 'daɲɛgɛso' (lattice/window); 'ɲɛfunɛ-so' (chimney) ye Anngilɛ kan-fili ye — Heburukan ka daɲɛ ye seben-ɲɛfɛlan (lattice) de ye.

notes.subject: משכים
notes.gloss: 'min bɛ sɔgɔma kɔrɔ tɛmɛ' — שׁכם ka kɔrɔ ye sɔgɔma-taali ye, 'a bɛ sɔgɔma don' walima 'sunusun min bɔra sɔgɔma' (sunusun dɔgɔya).
kumasen in bɛ misali-naani ɲɔgɔn lamini: kilisi-sunun-burukɛ-ɲɛfunɛ — fɛn caman minnu bɛ bɔ o yɛrɛ ma (vanishing), gɛlɛya bɛ Bamanankan na k'o kɔrɔ bɛɛ jira kelen-kelen.

translation: O la, olu bɛna tɛmɛ i n'a fɔ sɔgɔma kilisi, ni sɔgɔma sunusun min bɛ taa, ni burukɛnɛ min bɛ jiri-ɲɛnama sanfɛsa la bɔ foro kɔnɔ, ni ɲɛfunɛ min bɔ da la.

tokens.gloss: olu bɛna tɛmɛ i n'a fɔ
